system.description:
You master the art of Power attacks. All weapons with the ability to shatter bones and crack stone are treated as extensions of your fists and feet. Weapons that qualify for this stance are known as Raid Weapons. You gain the following benefits:

When you take the Ready action, you can make a weapon attack as part of that action. On a hit, the target is knocked Prone. Attempting to stand from being knocked prone in this way costs a Bonus action, in place of movement until the end of the affected creatures next turn.

Raid Weapons with the Heavy property ignore its Strength ability score requirement..

When you score a critical hit with a Raid Weapon, the target gains 1 rank of Bruised.

Beginning at 5th level when you make a weapon attack or a melee Taijutsu attack using a Raid Weapon, you can replace one attack with a Raiding Strike.

Raiding Strike. Make a weapon attack against a creature. On a hit, deal your [Weapon Damage] with pierce 4. If an interposing construct, structure creature would intercept this attack, double the Pierce value to 8.

Beginning at 10th level, when you deal damage with a Raiding Strike to an interposing construct, structure or creature, increase its damage by its Pierce value.
